evento.empieza: The game begins. {jugador} takes the first turn.
evento.turno: {jugador} is up to roll in round {ronda}.
evento.dados.dobles: {jugador} rolls doubles with a {total} and rolls again.
evento.salida: {jugador} passes Start and collects their salary.
evento.subasta.frenesi: Feeding frenzy triggers an auction for {casilla}.
evento.subastaDesierta: Nobody bids and the auction closes without a sale.
evento.alquiler: {jugador} lands on {casilla} and pays {cantidad:dinero} rent to {dueno}.
evento.sinAlquiler.hipotecada: {jugador} pays no rent on {casilla}: property is mortgaged.
evento.sinAlquiler.obras: {jugador} pays no rent on {casilla}: endless roadworks in progress.
evento.sinAlquiler.hiberna: {jugador} pays no rent on {casilla} due to hibernation.
evento.deuda: {jugador} is short on cash and owes {cantidad:dinero} to {acreedor}.
evento.bancarrota.jugador: {jugador} goes bankrupt and surrenders everything to {acreedor}.
evento.alCalabozo.auditoria: {jugador} lands on Audit! and ends up in the Lockup.
evento.alCalabozo.tres-dobles: {jugador} rolls three consecutive doubles and lands in the Lockup.
evento.alCalabozo.carta: A card sends {jugador} to the Lockup.
evento.saleDelCalabozo.dobles: {jugador} rolls doubles and walks out of the Lockup.
evento.saleDelCalabozo.fianza: {jugador} pays bail and leaves the Lockup.
evento.saleDelCalabozo.salvoconducto: {jugador} uses a safe-conduct and leaves the Lockup.
evento.masPobre: {jugador} receives aid for having the lowest net worth.
evento.venderEdificio: {jugador} sells a building on {casilla} to the bank for {cantidad:dinero}.
evento.deshipotecar: {jugador} pays off the mortgage on {casilla} for {coste:dinero}.
evento.habilidad.esprint: {jugador} activates Sprint to add a third die.
evento.habilidad.prestamo-expres: {jugador} takes an Express Loan of {cantidad:dinero} from the bank.
evento.habilidad.hibernar: {jugador} goes into hibernation: pays no rent and collects none.
evento.habilidad.temporada-alta: {jugador} declares peak season on all properties.
evento.habilidad.obras-eternas: {jugador} halts {casilla} belonging to {objetivo} with endless roadworks.
evento.habilidad.hormiguero: {jugador} activates Anthill to double tolls without a limit.
evento.habilidad.imprevisto: {jugador} triggers a Black Swan event: {objetivo} loses their next turn.
evento.finEfecto.inflada: {jugador}'s bubble bursts: the street enters a downturn.
evento.finEfecto.estallada: The slump on {jugador}'s street ends and rent returns to normal.
evento.finEfecto.rally: {jugador}'s rally concludes and shares return to normal trading.
evento.finEfecto.hibernar: {jugador} wakes from hibernation and rejoins the market.
evento.finEfecto.obras: Roadworks finish and rent collection resumes for {jugador}.
evento.prestamoDevuelto: {jugador} repays their Express Loan of {cantidad:dinero} with interest.
evento.pierdeTurno: {jugador} loses their turn due to a black swan event.
evento.frenesi: {jugador} lands on {casilla} under the effect of feeding frenzy.
evento.rachaFinal: {jugador} reaches the net worth goal: needs only to reach Start.
evento.rachaPerdida: {jugador} drops below the net worth goal and loses the streak.
evento.fin.meta: Victory! {jugador} reaches Start having achieved the goal and wins.
evento.fin.bancarrota: Victory! {jugador} prevails after all opponents go bankrupt.
evento.fin.tiempo: Time is up: {jugador} wins with the highest net worth.
